policy.name: Arunachal Pradesh Industrial Development and Investment Policy, 2025 (APIDIP 2025)
policy.order_no: No. DOI-13/5/2024 (Arunachal Pradesh Gazette Extraordinary No. 118, Vol. XXXII, 09.04.2025)

schemes.name: APIDIP 2025 Capital Investment Incentive (P&M Rs 5-25 lakh)
schemes.notes: Only for P&M investment between Rs 5 lakh and Rs 25 lakh. 50% of P&M; +10% of the computed subsidy for Priority Sector units and +10% for units with >=50% (or 5) skilled workforce APST/permanent residents, all within the Rs 15 lakh cap. New units and substantial expansion (once). New P&M at arm's length; physical verification mandatory. Priority Sectors = Annexure-III (food processing, NTFP/bamboo/cane/medicinal/tea/coffee, textiles/handloom/handicraft, ODOP, GI products, EV charging, pharmaceuticals, waste-to-wealth, tourism etc.).

schemes.name: APIDIP 2025 Capital Investment Incentive (P&M above Rs 25 lakh up to Rs 50 lakh)
schemes.notes: Only for P&M investment above Rs 25 lakh and up to Rs 50 lakh. 50% of P&M; +10% of computed subsidy for Priority Sector and +10% for >=50% (or 10) local skilled workforce, within the Rs 30 lakh cap. NO state capital subsidy for P&M above Rs 50 lakh (use central UNNATI CII). Priority Sectors = Annexure-III (food processing, NTFP/bamboo/cane/medicinal/tea/coffee, textiles/handloom/handicraft, ODOP, GI products, EV charging, pharmaceuticals, waste-to-wealth, tourism etc.).

schemes.name: APIDIP 2025 Capital Interest Subvention (P&M Rs 5-25 lakh)
schemes.notes: 6% p.a. (8% for Priority Sector) on term loan for P&M, 5 consecutive years; TOTAL cap Rs 10 lakh over 5 years (Rs 15 lakh Priority Sector). Unit must bear at least 2% interest (subvention reduced accordingly). On disbursed amount; SCB/RBI-registered FI loans only; disbursement after commercial production. New units and substantial expansion.

schemes.name: APIDIP 2025 Capital Interest Subvention (P&M above Rs 25 lakh)
schemes.notes: 5% p.a. (6% Priority Sector), 5 consecutive years; TOTAL cap Rs 20 lakh over 5 years (Rs 25 lakh Priority Sector). Unit bears minimum 2% interest. Same conditions as 7.3(2).

schemes.name: APIDIP 2025 Working Capital Interest Subvention
schemes.notes: WORKING CAPITAL loan (not term loan). 5% p.a. for 5 years from registration; unit bears min 1%; total cap Rs 50 lakh over 5 years and <=100% of P&M investment. New and existing GST-registered units.

schemes.name: APIDIP 2025 Power subsidy (MSME)
schemes.notes: Rs 2.00/unit for 5 years from commercial production; cap Rs 75 lakh PER ANNUM and total <=100% of P&M cost. Only 11kV/33kV connections from Dept of Power, Arunachal. Front-ended remission in power bill. New units / substantial expansion.

schemes.name: APIDIP 2025 Net SGST reimbursement
schemes.notes: Keys are ENTERPRISE CATEGORIES (no zoning). 100% of net SGST (gross SGST less ITC) for 7 years from commercial production; ceiling 250%/200%/180% of eligible investment. Production must stay >=70% of preceding 5-yr average for next 5 years. No similar benefit under any other scheme (para 5.1(4)) - interacts with UNNATI MSLI. New units / substantial expansion.

schemes.name: APIDIP 2025 Quality certification & testing equipment
schemes.notes: 35% of cost of in-house testing equipment and quality certification (GMP, ISO, BIS, BEE, AGMARK, ZED etc.), max Rs 5 lakh; sanctioned after certificate obtained. New and existing units.

other_benefits: Stamp duty & registration fee: 100% reimbursement for land in Govt industrial estates/parks (para 7.1).
Green energy (10-2000 kW RE): 50% of cost up to Rs 25 lakh; wastewater recycling 50% up to Rs 2 lakh; pollution control devices 50% up to Rs 10 lakh (para 7.5).
Common Facility Centre use: 50% up to Rs 1 lakh/yr for 3 years (para 7.9).
DPR consultancy for underprivileged: 95% up to Rs 1 lakh (para 7.11); air freight 50%; export transport 60% (paras 7.12+).
unverifiable: Policy in force 'until further orders'; registration period 3 years from notification (para 5.6) i.e. to about 01.04.2028 unless extended - window.to is derived, not stated.
Operational guidelines (para 5.7) not found; claim procedures not captured.
Para 5.5: units already registered under the 2020 policy cannot claim under 2025 policy.
